prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1152; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine, but I do need you to confirm you're the person who was in the vehicle that was involved in the collision.

A: Yes, I was the passenger in the car.

Q: Okay. Can you walk me through what happened in your own words?

A: We were in Pasadena, Texas, heading to a store. The driver was making a left turn at an intersection and another vehicle came through and hit us on the passenger side of the car.

Q: Was the driver turning on a green light or a flashing arrow?

A: I think it was a green light. I was looking at my phone so I didn't pay close attention.

Q: Did you feel the impact right away?

A: Yes. I was jolted forward and then pushed back into the seat. My head snapped a bit.

Q: Did you hit anything with your head or body?

A: No, I don't think so. My head didn't hit the window or anything like that.

Q: When did you first notice pain or stiffness?

A: Later that same evening. My neck got stiff and sore, and by the next morning it was harder to turn my head to the left.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other provider for this?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic two days after the accident. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me some medication and exercises.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness now and then from sitting at a desk, but nothing I needed treatment for.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident or your injuries?

A: Not that I can think of right now. I'm still doing my physical therapy exercises.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing with next steps.
